title: Snakes in the Reeds
html:
Coral snakes in the valley southeast of Underleaf keep biting my cutting crews. Kill ten and the timber gets through. Find me at the Silver Mine. (Dace Morrow)

About

Given byDace Morrow
Level12
LengthShort
KindSide
Quest points0

What you need

Nothing to bring.

Steps

  1. Talk to Dace Morrow (outdoors near Underleaf Silver Mine) to get the quest.
  2. Kill 10 coral snakes southeast of Underleaf (10)
  3. Report to Dace Morrow in Underleaf at -84, 202

Rewards

Reward
Gold140
Character XP5,000

What Dace Morrow says

Dace Morrow: Ten of the big ones? My crews will stop jumping at every stick on the ground.

Dace Morrow: Here's what the notice promised. They'll breed back, so keep an eye on the board.

Handing it in

"My crews can work again. Check the board tomorrow."
